OTP-ScoutSettings

Accounts

Add account

Proton Mail Bridge: server 127.0.0.1, port 1143, STARTTLS, accept self-signed certificate, and the bridge password shown in the Bridge app. Codes arrive up to ~40 s late – the Bridge polls Proton only every 20–40 s.

Tag

Rules are assigned to this account by its tag. It stays the same when the account is renamed; renaming it here moves all its rules along.

Rules

Rules are checked from top to bottom; the first match wins. An account without rules uses the built-in rule {code} is your verification code.

New rule

Catalog

Preconfigured rules for common services, loaded from the OTP-Scout catalog on GitHub. + adds the rules of the selected language for all accounts, ▾ lets you pick accounts. They then appear under Rules.

API

Local HTTP endpoint to show codes and links from outside, e.g. from a Tampermonkey script. Listens on 127.0.0.1 only; every request needs the token.

Only links starting with one of these are shown, e.g. https://claude.ai/magic-link. Empty list = any https:// link is accepted.

Endpoints

Code
POST /api/otp/code {"code": "…", "ruleName": "…"}
Link
POST /api/otp/link {"link": "…", "ruleName": "…"}
